svg.text: CPU Timeline · Compare periods (RT) — wireframe v1
Sub-view inside CPU Timeline tab. URL: /retellect/[pilotId]?tab=timeline&view=compare

g.text: Filter bar — two periods locked to equal length
⚠ Period A (Apr 25–May 1) is older than 14 days. Minute-level data is partial; some metrics derived from hourly trend.
Headline KPI cards (Δ = B − A; green = improvement, red = regression, neutral ±2pp = noise)
Host delta table — sortable, default sort: Δ% asc (best improvement first)
Net Δ: −620 min above 70% threshold across pilot
• Sub-view selector is a segmented control inside CPU Timeline tab; URL ?view=compare for shareable deeplinks.
• Period B length is locked to Period A length — the B "to" date input is read-only.
• Δ color: green = improvement (less time above threshold), red = regression, neutral chip for ±2pp "noise" band.
• Threshold values limited to {50, 60, 70, 80, 90}% because Zabbix getCpuHistoryDaily returns minutesAbove bins in 10pp steps only.
• Drill-down expansion stays inside the table; "Open in heatmap" navigates back to the heatmap sub-view with that host pre-selected.
